What happens during the Accelerator? AppWorks Community Founder in Our Alumni Network Guidance from proven founders How Will It Help My Fundraising? Activities Ready to Apply? Why Join? Twice a year , we invite only the most driven, strategic-minded, and fastest-moving founders to join AppWorks Accelerator, an intensive three-month program. Upon joining, you’re immediately part of a community of 50 batchmates, 100+ mentors , and 2,000+ alumni — all founders and here to help you grow , whether you’re building your first prototype or already leading your market and expanding into new ones . Our accelerator offers personalized mentorship, hands-on fundraising guidance, and curated business development opportunities with leading corporates across the region. You’ll also tap into a powerful network of founders, investors, and strategic partners — all committed to helping you grow, both as a founder and as a business. At our Demo Days in Taipei, Singapore, and Kuala Lumpur , you’ll have the chance to pitch your startup to hundreds of curated investors and potential business partners, offering extended opportunities to build meaningful partnerships. Best of all, the entire program is completely

Achieve Better Product-Market Fit, Win Key Business Partners, and Become a Better Founder Building in deep tech and regulated sectors takes more than technical skill — it requires insight, precision, and trusted allies.

Whether you’re advancing manufacturing automation with AI, developing frontier defense technologies, redefining financial infrastructure, building the next generation of on-chain banking systems, or securing systems against quantum threats , you can’t do it alone.

Joining AppWorks Accelerator means surrounding yourself with founders solving equally complex problems, sharing hard-won lessons, and gaining direct access to corporate partners and investors who can help you scale faster and smarter.

AW#34 Requests for Startups (RFSs) While AppWorks welcomes founders working on any ideas to join, for AW#34, we’re specifically calling for founders building startups in the following verticals : AW#34 RFS#1 : Manufacturing AI AI is transforming how factories design, produce, and optimize.

With Taiwan’s unmatched hardware and supply chain ecosystem, AppWorks provides direct access to manufacturing partners, OEMs, and corporate collaborators, while also enabling founders to co-develop and test smart manufacturing solutions alongside our community of AI innovators.

AW#34 RFS#2 : Defense Tech As global security and autonomy become increasingly critical, dual-use technologies such as robotics, sensing, cybersecurity, AI models, and advanced materials are redefining national and industrial resilience.

AppWorks’ regional network of deep-tech founders, hardware experts, institutional partners, and top R&D talent offers a strategic environment for developing and testing next-generation defense solutions.

AppWorks supports builders modernizing financial infrastructure with Web3 technologies, providing access to fintech investors, regional banking partners, and mentors experienced in compliance and scaling in regulated markets.
AW#34 RFS#4 : PQC The encryption currently protecting the global digital economy is mathematically vulnerable to quantum computers, and the threat isn’t only future-dated.

AppWorks will connect PQC founders directly to Taiwan’s semiconductor and hardware ecosystem , alongside an LP network in finance, telecom, manufacturing, and defense that represents the industries where PQC adoption is most urgent.

Whether you’re building the next-gen AI factory, advancing dual-use technology, reimagining the future of finance, or securing the post-quantum future, AppWorks is not just an accelerator; it’s your strategic partner for entering Taiwan and scaling across Asia.

The emphasis on peer learning with many talented and dedicated fellow founders and mentorship with a plethora of successful serial entrepreneurs within the AppWorks ecosystem has been instrumental in shaping my entrepreneurial mindset and approach. 'If you want to go fast, go alone, if you want to go far, go together.' Here, AppWorks and all fellow founders go together with you!

Blog Wistron Accelerator Wistron Accelerator Powered by AppWorks Wistron Accelerator #11 is Now Taking Applications! Calling founders working in AI, IoT, Cloud, Cyber Security, EdTech and MedTech to join us. Wistron is one of the world’s leading manufacturers in the ICT industry. In recent years, Wistron has been investing in R&D, tech innovation, and diversified product development, and has also seized on the growing trend of cloud applications. They have successfully integrated a multitude of hardware devices, software services, and cloud applications, and offer technical service platforms and solutions. During this time, they have also expanded their business to new fields like education, corporate services, and medical care. With an eye toward building a sustainable, long-term business, Wistron is actively looking into growth opportunities for the next decade, including strategic investments and technology partners, and in recent years has already invested more than NT$13 billion in over 60 companies. To foster collaboration with new startups, in 2021, Wistron has set up the investment office (CVC), and launched the Wistron Accelerator Program with AppWorks, a leading launchpad for bold and ambitious entrepreneurs targeting Greater Southeast Asia (GSEA). The Wistron
The Wistron Accelerator is operated by AppWorks and will be held twice a year and recruit a limited number of 7 startups per batch.

In addition to AppWorks Funds, Wistron also invested in AppWorks Accelerator startups such as MoBagel (AW#16), ANIWARE (AW#17) , Authme (AW#18) and Aiello (AW#20), building up long-term partnerships and relationships with each company.
By 2025 Q4, there were up to 653 active startups, with a total of 2,086 founders in AppWorks Accelerator’s ecosystem.

Many of the once early-stage startups have scaled up and are ready to work with large-scale customers or expand into new industries and new markets – Successful enterprises have the resources for startups to experiment and grow, and startups can provide enterprises with opportunities to innovate.

Some domain-specific perks include: Access to C-level Mentors from Wistron Group PoC with Wistron Group A subsidy of NT$ 200K sponsored by Wistron Microsoft / GCP / AWS Cloud Credits Requests for Startups Wistron Accelerator hopes to recruit startups that can utilize cutting-edge technology and find growth momentum for the next decade.
Focus criteria includes (but are not limited to) AI, IoT, cloud, cybersecurity, EduTech, and MedTech.

We hope that through this accelerator program, startups and Wistron Group can work together and experiment with new technology solutions that could bring about growth opportunities beyond Wistron Group’s existing business.
Application for Wistron Accelerator #11 is now closed.

Blog Wistron Accelerator Wistron Accelerator FAQ (For Founders Applying to Wistron Accelerator #11) AppWorks December 1, 2025 in Accelerator Wistron has been working closely with AppWorks since 2014 and is one of the major limited partners of AppWorks Fund II and Fund III. It also invested in MoBagel (AW#16), ANIWARE (AW#17), Authme (AW#18), Aiello (AW#20) , and other alumni who have graduated from AppWorks Accelerator. Wistron and AppWorks have been working closely together and have a long-term strategic partnership, and launched the Wistron Accelerator in September 2021. AppWorks, itself a leading accelerator in Greater Southeast Asia, provides core logistics and operations support. We put together some frequently asked questions for startup teams who still had questions about the Wistron Accelerator program after reading the information on the landing page. If you have similar questions, we hope you can find the answers below. [Wistron Accelerator #11 is taking applications now!] 1. What outcomes does Wistron Group expect to achieve through the Accelerator program? What kind of support can Wistron Group provide? Some domain-specific perks include: a. Access to C-level Mentors from Wistron Group The most significant
Access to C-level Mentors from Wistron Group The most significant value of this accelerator is that the C-levels of different business units at Wistron Group will serve as your Mentors.
Startups in the Wistron Accelerator can directly discuss partnerships and business insights with C-level Mentors at Wistron Group, significantly increasing the chance of collaborative success.

The Mentors participating in the Wistron Accelerator are from the following business units: Wistron Group (including the CVC team) Wiwynn WNC WITS WMT WiAdvance People who have experience working with enterprises know that the CEO or C-level manager is usually responsible for the strategy, and their team is accountable for execution.
In the Wistron Accelerator program, Mentors take on the role to solve the aforementioned issues.
During the accelerator period, startups will have in-depth collaboration and interaction with the heads of the designated business unit.

Exclusive PoC collaboration with Wistron Group Startups running B2B businesses know that it takes a long time to successfully onboard corporate partners because of the different organizational nature and the longer decision-making processes.
Wistron Accelerator has thoughtfully planned the schedule, process, and goals to speed up the collaboration process.
The startups participating in the Wistron Accelerator will directly collaborate with Wistron Group to come up with a PoC.
The application review process combines AppWorks’ experience in mentoring startups and Wistron’s industry expertise.
The following questions can help you think about whether you are suitable to join Wistron Accelerator: Why did you start your business?
Is there a charge for the Wistron Accelerator?
Wistron Accelerator is an entirely free service for founders.

Blog Wistron Accelerator Wistron Accelerator FAQ 緯創加速器常見問題回覆 (為 #11 申請團隊準備) AppWorks December 1, 2025 in Accelerator 緯創資通與 AppWorks 從 2014 年開始合作，是 AppWorks Fund II、Fund III 的主要股東之一，之後也陸續投資了 MoBagel (AW#16)、 ANIWARE (AW#17)、 Authme (AW#18) 與 Aiello (AW#20) 等自 AppWorks Accelerator 畢業的新創校友，雙方有長期的策略合作關係與默契，並於 2021 年 9 月首度啓動緯創垂直加速器，由大東南亞領先的新創加速器 AppWorks 提供營運等核心業務。 計畫申請緯創加速器的新創團隊，也許對本計畫將有更近一步的疑問，因此，我們整理了以下常見問題，希望可以協助創業者從中得到解答。 【Wistron Accelerator #11 現正開放申請中： 申請專頁 】 1. 緯創集團期待藉由加速器與新創達成什麼樣的合作成果？緯創集團可以提供新創什麼幫助？ Wistron Accelerator 可以提供的相關幫助包括： 緯創集團各企業 / 事業單位高階主管提供產業面的專業建議 這個加速器的最大特色，是由緯創集團各企業與事業單位高階主管擔任 Mentors，加入的新創可直接與 Mentor 們討論合作內容與商業模式，從他們身上，獲得產業最前緣的 Insights，大幅減少新創摸索、試錯與實驗的機會成本。緯創集團參與 Wistron Accelerator 的企業與事業單位如下： Wistron 緯創資通 (包含CVC 企業投資辦公室) Wiwynn 緯穎科技 WNC 啟碁科技 WITS 緯致科技 WMT 緯創醫學 WiAdvance 緯謙科技 有與企業合作經驗的創業者都知道，通常高階主管負責策略，而團隊負責執行，因此如果能直接與最高層級溝通，那麼在策略合作聚焦，以及共同發展出新服務、新事業的機會將因此大增。 除此之外，當新創與企業合作時，常遇到的挑戰是，即便新創在本身領域具備一定的專業能力，但面對每一個不同領域的產業、每一家組織規模更大的企業，都是仍有許多需要更深入掌握的軟硬知識與技術。 因此，Wistron Accelerator 在內容設計上，一開始就由高階主管親自上陣，解決上述問題。 新創在加速器期間，將與各事業單位負責人進行深度的合作與互動，不只能更深入理解企業真正的需求與計畫、產業 Insight，也能藉此學習如何與企業客戶有效溝通、幫助解決他們的問題。 與緯創集團獨家合作 PoC 做 B2B 生意的新創都知道，因為企業組織與決策流程的關係，要成功推動企業合作，通常需要醞釀比較長的時間，動輒一季、甚至超過半年，都是常有的情形。 為了加速合作的速度，Wistron Accelerator
